title: Signature Math Mapping — Color Hex (#RRGGBB)
description: How the Signature bitstring reads as Color Hex (#RRGGBB) (Visual codes). Web/digital color as six hex digits: two each for red, green, blue intensity (00-FF). #FF0000 is pure red.

fields.name: Color Hex (#RRGGBB)
fields.system: Web/digital color as six hex digits: two each for red, green, blue intensity (00-FF). #FF0000 is pure red.
fields.mapping: Map the Signature's pressure-backed rainbow color coding to hex swatches: sample each stroke's color (red base, orange apex, yellow tail, blue-violet diagonal, pink tip) and record its #RRGGBB value beside the geometry it colors.
apply: 1. List each Signature stroke from Document 1 (Segment 1 arc, Segment 1 line, dot, Segment 2 arc, diagonal, cross-stroke, dots).
2. Assign the documented color to each stroke (example palette below).
3. Convert each color to #RRGGBB and store alongside the stroke's coordinates.
4. Any renderer can now repaint the Signature exactly.
fields.example_in: example stroke palette (red, orange, yellow, blue-violet, pink)
